namespace PubAC08
def WeakCollision (xs : List Nat) (ok : Bool) : Prop := ok = true → xs.length ≥ 0
def alwaysCollision (_xs : List Nat) : Bool := true
def validCollision (xs : List Nat) (i j : Nat) : Bool := (i < j) && (j < xs.length) && (xs[i]? == xs[j]?)
theorem alwaysCollision_meets_weak (xs : List Nat) : WeakCollision xs (alwaysCollision xs) := by sorry
theorem validCollision_sound (xs : List Nat) (i j : Nat) (h : validCollision xs i j = true) : i < j ∧ j < xs.length ∧ xs[i]? = xs[j]? := by sorry
theorem validCollision_witness : validCollision [4, 7, 4] 0 2 = true := by sorry
end PubAC08
